limitations: Two known rigid surfaces and 14 previously used starts; no unseen-surface or disturbance test.
Two seeds share the same conditions; repetitions are not independent generalization evidence.
This is residual PPO around an offline reference motion. Actor and critic also receive the reference and phase.
Whole-body torque is an effort proxy, not electrical energy or a global optimum.
Effort comparisons include only common full-duration support successes. Fixed standing is a retention baseline, not a successful sitting trajectory.
Geometry truth is used only for reset construction, reward and offline labels; reference paths are an explicit offline scaffold.
Command traces are sampled at 10 Hz; the frozen controller applies its slew constraint at 50 Hz.
The frozen support gate requires at least 0.05 bodyweight of normal support load. Passing it is not proof that most weight has transferred to the surface or that the posture minimizes torque.
Because the curriculum stopped at failed gates, earlier starts including standing were evaluated but never trained. Per-policy trained_start_stages are recorded separately.
